# At Home Realty

> Real estate brokerage serving international buyers, sellers, and
> investors in Mexico's Riviera Maya. Licensed realtor Craig Verbeck,
> AMPI certified, with eXp Realty México. Family-run since 2011.

## What we do
- Buyer representation for condos, homes, and investment property
- Full-service listing and selling of Riviera Maya real estate
- Vacation rental / property management for owners
- Legal due diligence and closing support for international buyers

## Where we work
Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Puerto Aventuras, and Akumal, Quintana Roo, Mexico.

## Who we are
Craig Verbeck, licensed real estate agent, 14+ years in the Riviera Maya.
AMPI member. eXp Realty México / At Home Realty.
